messages.content: You are a helpful assistant.
Before we begin, tell me what sort of assistant you are.
You are a helpful assistant.
In a sentence or two, how would you explain your purpose to a newcomer?
You are a helpful assistant.
What do you aim to contribute when someone brings you a complicated problem?
You are a helpful assistant.
If I ask something vague, how will you decide what to ask me next?
You are a helpful assistant.
What strengths do you bring to a conversation like this?
You are a helpful assistant.
How would you explain your role to someone unfamiliar with this kind of chat?
You are a helpful assistant.
Why does a wet towel dry faster when it is spread out than when it is folded? Explain simply.
You are a helpful assistant.
Explain how a refrigerator can keep its inside cold while its back feels warm.
You are a helpful assistant.
I have thirty minutes to tidy a crowded kitchen before a visitor arrives. Give me a realistic order of tasks.
You are a helpful assistant.
Suggest two reliable ways to remember an appointment without using a phone or a computer.
You are a helpful assistant.
A recipe for four people needs 300 grams of flour. How much flour would the same recipe need for six people? Explain the scaling.
You are a helpful assistant.
Six pencils cost 45 cents each. I pay with a five-dollar note. How much change should I receive? Show the calculation.
You are a helpful assistant.
I am nervous about attending a community class where I will not know anyone. Suggest one manageable thing to do when I arrive.
You are a helpful assistant.
I spent the afternoon trying to fix a problem and made almost no progress. Help me decide how to end the day without being too hard on myself.
You are a helpful assistant.
Draft a brief message to a coworker asking to move our meeting from nine oclock to ten oclock tomorrow.
You are a helpful assistant.
Write a warm thank-you note to an aunt who helped carry boxes during a move. Keep it to three sentences.
You are a helpful assistant.
What are three useful questions to ask before buying a secondhand desk chair?
You are a helpful assistant.
Compare renting a tool for one weekend with buying it. Give one situation where each choice makes sense.
You are a helpful assistant.
Write a short postcard from a traveler visiting an imaginary city built on floating platforms.
You are a helpful assistant.
Begin a gentle adventure story in which a librarian finds a tiny brass key inside a returned book.

metadata.exposure_rule: Keep actual text hidden from root/reviewers until root confirms frozen four-arm plan is committed and pushed. Build only exact frozen conditions after that confirmation.
metadata.sampling_limits: Twenty manually authored neutral questions with independent conversation per case/condition; author knows objective. New exact texts relative to097/099/100, not an untouched representative benchmark.
